story: Until 2026-12-29 (32 days), options price BANKNIFTY to move about ±4.0%, roughly 60,741 to 65,771. In the past, the price ended inside the range priced this way 62% of the time.
Options are cheap compared with how much BANKNIFTY has actually been moving: they price 17.0% a year while the last month realised 22.7%.
BANKNIFTY futures trade 240.3 points above the price itself. That premium works out to 4.3% a year, lower than almost any day this past year: hedgers or short sellers are leaning on the futures.
BANKNIFTY has actually been moving about 1.43% a day this past month: on the high side for it against the past year.

skew.analyst: 25-delta risk reversal -1.18 vol pts (front month), 73rd percentile of the past year. More negative = more demand for downside insurance relative to upside.

oi.simple: For the 2026-12-29 expiry, the biggest pile of call positions is at 66,000 (+4.7% away) and the biggest pile of put positions is at 60,000 (-4.8%). Option sellers defend these levels, so price often slows near them, but they shift as positions change.
oi.analyst: Front-expiry PCR (OI) 0.90; all-expiry OI PCR at the 43rd percentile of the past year. Today's change: calls +452,700, puts +443,100 (OI units, i.e. shares or index quantity). A high PCR in India mostly reflects put writing, so it is read as crowding, not as a signal.

futures.analyst: Near-month basis +240.3, annualised carry 4.3% (10th percentile of the past year; its 1-year median 6.8%). Last 5 sessions (price x OI, same contracts day to day): Short covering, Long unwinding, Long build-up, Long unwinding, Short build-up. Build-up labels describe what happened to positions; they do not say who is right.
